column4: componentize-py is not installed on this runner (the scheduled engine-race job sets up no Python), and this test needs a real Python build: it compiles python-sdk/examples/all_host_calls_workflow.py with python-sdk/scripts/build_wasm.py, takes the CPython core module out of the component and counts the copy-on-write memory-image mappings that eight instances add to the process. Whole test with no dialect arm. NOT MEASURED on this job: the count of 1 is the one skip site in the test (the toolchain check), read from the source, not a reading of the job's own report; if the first report differs, correct this line. It runs for real in Tier 1 Gate, where python is installed and a skip is a failure, and in scripts/docker/python-toolchain.Dockerfile (measured there 2026-11-22: passes with the dense rewrite, fails with 0 mappings without it). (cleat#4382)
